subject.title: [Bug]: Slack reaction_added/reaction_removed events never delivered via Socket Mode (multi-account, v2026.3.24)

question: Should maintainers require live current-main multi-account Slack reaction envelope proof before queueing a fix for this issue?
rationale: Source inspection shows real handler and filter boundaries, but the reported failure occurs before any logged reaction event, so an automated fix would be guessing at the first drop point.

options.title: Collect live envelope proof first
options.body: Ask for or run a redacted current-main Slack repro that captures raw Socket Mode reaction envelopes, account IDs, gateway status, and trace logs before changing code.

options.title: Fold into broader Socket Mode triage
options.body: Treat this as part of the broader Slack Socket Mode delivery/liveness investigation only if the broader issue gets reaction-specific evidence.

options.title: Attempt a speculative filter fix
options.body: Patch the account/filter or authorization path without live envelopes, accepting a higher chance of missing the true Slack/Bolt delivery failure.

recommendation.title: Collect live envelope proof first
recommendation.body: Ask for or run a redacted current-main Slack repro that captures raw Socket Mode reaction envelopes, account IDs, gateway status, and trace logs before changing code.

likelyOwner.reason: The referenced merged fix and current reaction system-event routing history make this the best available routing owner for the proof decision.
